title: Finding remediation descriptor
description: Describes what can be done about one finding, and what it will cost. sideEffects are computed for THIS file, not declared statically for the action: removing metadata from an unsigned PDF does not invalidate a signature, and claiming it might would train users to ignore the warning. The static, per-action superset lives in the capability declaration (issue #23).

action.description: The recommended action. Required when supported is true.

sideEffects.description: Effects that apply to this file if the recommended action runs. An empty array is a positive claim that none of the six classes apply - it is not a default.

alternativeActions.description: Other actions that also resolve this finding, with their own side effects. Lets the UI offer 'remove the annotation' or 'flatten the page' without the core deciding for the user.

actionGroupId.description: Findings sharing an actionGroupId are executed as ONE operation by the remediation engine. Five author/creator/producer findings are five findings the user reviews individually, but one metadata write. This is how the contract answers deduplication without collapsing findings the user needs to see separately.

unsupportedDetail.description: Plain-language explanation shown to the user. Must not contain the detected value.
